name: FloralPro
description: A self-contained, browser-based app for teaching the structure of the flower. A whorl-by-whorl model of each flower is drawn as a floral formula (classic and Prenner conventions), a floral diagram, a rotatable 3D flower and a labelled longitudinal section, all linked. It includes a flower builder with botanical consistency checks, an atlas of 115 variant plates with a glossary, 82 angiosperm families (APG IV) with 278 species and their status in Mexico, a multi-access and a generated dichotomous key, self-assessment with piece-by-piece grading and verifiable teacher exams, gymnosperm strobili in 3D (cycads, Ginkgo, conifers, Ephedra) with 24 Mexican species, and a classroom mode to project presentations and print family sheets, worksheets, strobilus sheets and study cards.
softwareRequirements: A modern web browser; no installation
